review_basis: Stage 8 reread every allowed test module and declared shared helper; inspected AST imports, module execution, fixture dependencies, every filesystem/process/service call site and the invoked helper bodies. Pure semantic tests operate on literals or invented tmp_path JSON/Markdown/XML; canonical references are not mounted as answers. Native SDK tests construct text/table objects only, without parsing or images. Parent conftest disabled; plugin autoload disabled; explicit asyncio only. Runtime audit rejects media, repository corpus and network I/O. Detailed review and frozen identities are retained with the stage evidence. The prior P01 synthetic unknown_origin assertion was reviewed and migrated to the Stage 8 duty-based contract: its reading tree/body remain complete without a crop consumer; source origin remains UNKNOWN and all four states and warning-only impact are now asserted. Real P01 field/cell/text assertions are unchanged. Added continuation-order and final-occurrence checks use immutable source identities and producer spans only. Final fixed-input V2 assertion review distinguishes actual CRLF codepoints 13/10 from literal backslashes and checks media URI audit declarations without decoding; immutable artifact retains the complete native root. All additional state/continuation/final-occurrence tests use only literals and existing source-free services.
